items.title: Humic acid: lick it first, or smell it first?
items.comment: q-1 smell it first for sure, that's like an allergy test, some ppl are super sensitive... some ppl also super sensitive to dmso altho that's more rare. in general it's good to try all these things in very low, increasing doses before they are needed in crisis.
items.fate: (a), in his words "smell it first": the Core Order's first step says to smell humic acid first and lick only if that doesn't help; his general advice (try these in very low, increasing doses before a crisis) goes to round 2 as a line to place

items.title: DMSO first: two cautions from the DMSO section
items.comment: q-3 what i meant sorry, don't take DMSO literally with  harmalas like don't put the harmala in the dmso or take them exactly at the same time, but it's totally fine to take them a bit apart like and there is no reason to take them together anyway the point is to take dmso if you already absorbed the harmalas and the aya is too crazy. if someone is worried about a bleed, i'd prob skip dmso but it depends on how severe their issue is, it's not a powerful blood thinner like heperin or something unless maybe injected, it's a dietary blood thinner basically altho you can check how strong consuming dmso is for that maybe some research idk, i've never had any issues with bleeding too much because of consuming dmso myself. never heard of it either but if that's already a medical issue i'd wanna think about that more
